svg.title: IEMOCAP test-split Shapley means and sample SDs

cc:Work.dc:title: IEMOCAP test-split Shapley means and sample SDs
cc:Work.dc:description: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ZsKgZztYMPOj76LL7eYWT07JJ4k0cWdaC1zmOlIy3q0/edit; "Shapley scores"!A4:H8. Modality Shapley contributions on the IEMOCAP test split. Dots indicate class means; horizontal whiskers show plus/minus one standard deviation across samples within each class, not confidence intervals. MoCap1, MoCap2, and MoCap3 denote hand, head, and rotated, respectively.
